item.tib: sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i gtso mchog thugs sgrub kyi lag len gsal byed nam mkha'i nyi zer
item.coloph: ces pa'i sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gtso mchog thugs sgrub kyi lag len gsal byed nam mkha'i nyi zer shar ba 'di ni/ skyes mchog mang pos bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas bris pa dge des g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
